Container.Name: ollama-vulkan
Container.Overview: Stock Ollama (always current) with Vulkan GPU acceleration for Intel Arc (B580, A770, A750, A380, ...). Same API on port 11434. For 2026-era models such as Gemma 4 that the IPEX-LLM based image cannot load. Requires an Intel Arc GPU with /dev/dri available on the host. Note: models larger than VRAM run partially offloaded (remainder on CPU).
Container.Requires: Intel Arc GPU with kernel driver loaded (/dev/dri on host). Vulkan backend is bundled in the stock image and auto-enables.

Config.Name: Model Storage
Config.Description: Separate model storage from the IPEX container. Models are large (4-20 GB each).

Config.Name: Ollama API Port
Config.Description: Port for the Ollama API. Change (e.g. 11435) if you run the IPEX container side by side.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_VULKAN
Config.Description: Enable the Vulkan GPU backend (bundled, auto-enables with /dev/dri; set explicitly to be sure). Set to 0 to force CPU.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Allowed origins for CORS. Set to * to allow Open WebUI and other frontends to connect.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
Config.Description: How long to keep a model loaded in VRAM after the last request. Use 5m, -1 for forever, 0 to unload immediately.
